fusions.name: Rooted Stamp
fusions.desc: Stamps the ground, dealing 3 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles, each with a 25% chance to be [Pinned] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Ledge Rebound
fusions.desc: A head-first spring that deals 14 damage, leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds and knocks it back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Toehold
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 16% for 12 seconds. Your movement speed rises 16% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Sure Landing

riders.text: your feet find the ledge before you do

fusions.desc: Raises your Speed by 1, and your Speed ceiling by 1. From bronze rank your dodge chance rises 5%, and from silver you move 5% faster.
